description_en: Queries the message accumulation for a specified group ID. The results include the number of stacked messages and the consumption latency
description_zh: 查询指定Group ID的消息消费堆积情况，包括当前消息堆积数量和消费延迟时间等
name: OnsConsumerAccumulate

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Group that you want to query
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to query the details of each topic. Valid values:

true: Queries the details. The details are returned in the DetailInTopicList parameter.

false: Does not query the details. This is the default value. The DetailInTopicList parameter returns empty
parameters.help_zh:
是否查询各个Topic的详细信息。取值说明如下：

true：要查询详细信息，返回DetailInTopicList参数的详细信息。

false：不查询详细信息（默认值），DetailInTopicList参数返回值为空
parameters.name: detail

Data.description_en: The message accumulation of the specified consumer

ConsumeTps.description_en: The total TPS of message consumption for the group of consumer instances that belong to the specified Group ID
ConsumeTps.description_zh: 该Group ID下消费者实例群组接收消息的总TPS

DelayTime.description_en:
The maximum message consumption latency for the Group ID. The value is the longest consumption latency among all topics to which the Group ID subscribes.

Unit: milliseconds
DelayTime.description_zh:
Group ID消费消息的最大延迟时间。取值为该Group ID订阅的所有Topic中，消费延迟时间最长的Topic的值。

单位：毫秒

DetailInTopicDo.description_en: The details of each topic. If the Detail parameter in the request is set to false, this parameter returns empty
DetailInTopicDo.description_zh: 各个Topic具体情况。如果请求参数Detail取值为fasle，则该返回参数的返回值为空

DelayTime.description_en:
The maximum message consumption latency in this topic. This is the time difference between the ready time of the earliest unconsumed message in the topic and the current time.

Unit: milliseconds
DelayTime.description_zh:
该Topic中消息消费的最大延迟时间。即Topic中最早一条未消费消息的就绪时间和当前的时间差。

单位：毫秒

LastTimestamp.description_en:
The production time of the most recently consumed message in the topic.

Unit: Unix timestamp in milliseconds
LastTimestamp.description_zh:
该Topic中最近消费的某条消息的生产时间。

单位：毫秒级的Unix时间戳

TotalDiff.description_en: The number of stacked messages in the topic

LastTimestamp.description_en:
The production time of the most recently consumed message in the group of consumer instances that belong to the specified Group ID.

Unit: Unix timestamp in milliseconds
LastTimestamp.description_zh:
该Group ID下消费者实例群组中最近消费的某条消息的生产时间。

单位：毫秒级的Unix时间戳

Online.description_en:
Indicates whether a consumer instance is online under this Group ID. If at least one consumer instance is online, the Group ID is considered online. Valid values:

true: Online

false: Offline
Online.description_zh:
该Group ID下是否有消费者实例在线；只要有一个消费者实例在线，该Group ID状态即为在线。取值说明如下：

true：状态为在线

false：状态为不在线

TotalDiff.description_en: The number of stacked messages for all topics to which the Group ID subscribes
TotalDiff.description_zh: 该Group ID订阅的所有Topic的消费堆积数量

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. This is a common parameter. Each request has a unique ID. Use this ID to locate and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 公共参数，每个请求的ID都是唯一的，可用于排查和定位问题
